definition: Kai-Fu Lee (traditional Chinese: 李開復; simplified Chinese: 李开复; pinyin: Lǐ Kāifù; born December 3, 1961) is a Taiwanese computer scientist, investor, and author.
details: Built the Sphinx continuous speech recognizer, founded Microsoft Research Asia and Google China, and leads open-source LLM startup 01.AI (Yi models). He was the founding director of Microsoft Research China, later Microsoft Research Asia, serving from 1998 to 2000, and served as president of Google China 2005 to 2009. In 2009, Lee founded the venture capital firm Innovation Works, later renamed Sinovation Ventures. In 2023, he founded 01.AI, a Chinese artificial intelligence (AI) company. Lee is the author of AI Superpowers (2018) and AI 2041 (with Chen Qiufan, 2021).

explainer.lead: Kai-Fu Lee is a Taiwanese computer scientist and investor. His work spans artificial intelligence, informatics, information technology and computing.
